commands.summary: Render a low-res ffmpeg proxy preview (trim+speed+audio, --burn-captions); not CapCut's final render.

options.name: encoder
options.description: Video encoder for the proxy (-c:v; default libx264). Hardware encoders like h264_videotoolbox/h264_nvenc/h264_qsv work when the build carries them; validated against `ffmpeg -encoders` before rendering.

options.name: soft_captions
options.description: Mux the text-track cues as a toggleable mov_text subtitle stream (the SRT is also written next to the output as <preview>.srt); skipped with a note when ffmpeg has no mov_text encoder.

options.name: progress
options.description: Stream ffmpeg's progress to stderr instead of buffering it.

output.description: JSON by default; use -H where supported for human output.

exit_codes.1: invalid input, warning, or operation failure

commands.name: detect-scenes
commands.summary: Detect scene-change cut points in a video (ffmpeg scene filter); prints cuts + segments to seed compile/cut.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Scene-change score a cut must exceed (0..1).

options.name: min_gap
options.description: Merge cuts closer than this many seconds, keeping the strongest.

options.name: limit
options.description: Keep only the N strongest cuts.

options.name: ffprobe_cmd
options.description: ffprobe binary for the video-stream duration (falls back to the container duration without it).

output.description: JSON by default; use -H where supported for human output.

exit_codes.1: invalid input, warning, or operation failure

commands.name: detect-silence
commands.summary: Detect silence spans in a media file (ffmpeg silencedetect); prints silences + keep segments to seed compile/cut.

options.name: threshold_db
options.description: Noise floor in dBFS; audio at or below this level counts as silence.

options.name: min_silence
options.description: Shortest silence to report, in seconds.

options.name: pad
options.description: Margin in seconds kept around speech: each silence span is shrunk by this on both ends so cuts never clip a word mid-syllable.

options.name: limit
options.description: Keep only the N longest silences.

options.name: ffprobe_cmd
options.description: ffprobe binary for the container duration (falls back to ffmpeg's stderr header without it).

output.description: JSON by default; use -H where supported for human output.

exit_codes.1: invalid input, warning, or operation failure

commands.name: detect-retakes
commands.summary: Find repeated takes in the draft's captions (or an SRT): windowed word-sequence similarity, later take kept; prints cuts + keep segments to seed compile/cut.

options.name: srt
options.description: Read cues from this SRT file instead of a draft (no <project> then).

options.name: window
options.description: Max seconds between the earlier cue's end and the later cue's start.

options.name: min_words
options.description: Cues with fewer normalised words never count as a take.

output.description: JSON by default; use -H where supported for human output.

exit_codes.1: invalid input, warning, or operation failure
